ideas.pitch: A low-cost automated waste sorting bin built from old cardboard and discarded electronics that classifies organic vs. recyclable scrap using an ESP32 camera module.
ideas.problem_statement: JUGAAD – Scrap to Solution: Reduce the burden of waste management that threatens public health and the environment by encouraging innovative ideas for waste utilization.
ideas.title: JugaadBot: Smart Waste Sorting Bin with ESP32
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the core theme of the Jugaad hackathon by turning physical scrap materials into a functional, working product with a live hardware demo.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-software hybrid that repurposes discarded e-waste circuit boards into a functioning home automation sensor node.
ideas.problem_statement: JUGAAD – Scrap to Solution: Encourage innovative ideas for waste utilization, process modifications, and technical solutions using scrap.
ideas.title: E-Waste Circuitry Upcycler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical scrap material utilization with a live working demo, matching the exact expectations of judges looking for upcycling solutions.

ideas.pitch: An automated agricultural drip irrigation controller built entirely from recycled plastic bottles, old motor pumps, and scrap microcontrollers.
ideas.problem_statement: JUGAAD – Scrap to Solution: Design and build innovative and practical solutions using scrap or recycled materials that can be used in real life.
ideas.title: AgriScrap drip controller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a clear, measurable social and agricultural impact while strictly using discarded materials as mandated by the event.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight local web application for local scrap yards and waste collectors to log incoming discarded materials and track upcycled product inventory.
ideas.problem_statement: JUGAAD – Scrap to Solution: Highlight the importance of upcycling, responsible waste management, and exploring the hidden potential of discarded materials.
ideas.title: RecycleLedger: Upcycled Material Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fills a practical logistics gap for local waste management workflows with a polished, fully functioning CRUD web interface.

ideas.pitch: A real-time composting sensor kit housed inside discarded plastic containers that measures temperature and moisture to optimize organic waste breakdown.
ideas.problem_statement: JUGAAD – Scrap to Solution: Convert waste into useful products with a focus on practical innovation, sustainability, and real-life usability.
ideas.title: SmartCompost Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates environmental sustainability with an IoT hardware prototype that works instantly during live judging.
